title: Guppy project status
description: Summary of a project's status. Lives at guppy/STATUS.json in each project repo and as projects/<id>.json in Guppy. See docs/status-contract.md.

description.description: What the project is, in one sentence.

status_text.description: Where the project stands now. Plain text, one or two sentences.

last_update.description: When the status last changed: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS ±HHMM.

last_update_unix.description: The same instant as last_update, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

url.description: Main link: the repo, or the website if there is no repo.

status_url.description: Raw URL of the project's guppy/STATUS.md, or null.

icon.description: Public URL of the project's icon, ideally a square 128x128 PNG, or null.
